title: Covolume = Fundamental Domain Volume
content: The central equivalence `covolume_eq_volume_fundamentalDomain` states that `ENNReal.ofReal L.covolume = volume (ZSpan.fundamentalDomain (L.toModuleBasis n))`. The proof uses three facts chained by `simp`: (1) `ZSpan.volume_fundamentalDomain` says `vol(fundDom b) = ENNReal.ofReal |det(Matrix.of b)|`; (2) `toModuleBasis_matrix_eq` says `Matrix.of (L.toModuleBasis n) = L.basis`; (3) `Lattice.covolume` unfolds to `|L.basis.det|`. Together these show the custom `|det|` formula and the ZSpan fundamental domain volume are the same quantity computed two ways.
mathContext: $\mathrm{covol}(L) = |\det(B)| = \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{F}_B)$ where $\mathcal{F}_B = \{\sum t_i b_i : t_i \in [0,1)\}$ is the fundamental parallelepiped.

title: Invertibility from Measure Theory
content: `basis_det_ne_zero` proves `(Matrix.of b).det ≠ 0` for any `Module.Basis (Fin n) ℝ (Fin n → ℝ)` using measure theory rather than linear algebra. The key is `ZSpan.measure_fundamentalDomain_ne_zero b (μ := volume)`: a lattice fundamental domain always has nonzero Haar measure (it tiles ℝ^n). Then `ZSpan.volume_fundamentalDomain` and `ENNReal.ofReal_ne_zero_iff` convert this to `0 < |det|`, and `abs_pos` gives `det ≠ 0`. This is the inverse construction gateway: it shows `Lattice.ofBasis` is well-typed. The `(μ := volume)` named argument is needed because `ZSpan.measure_fundamentalDomain_ne_zero` has an implicit `Measure` argument that Lean cannot infer from context outside the ZSpan namespace.
mathContext: A lattice $\Lambda \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ has $\mathrm{vol}(\mathbb{R}^n / \Lambda) = |\det B| > 0$ because the fundamental domain tiles $\mathbb{R}^n$, so $|\det B| \neq 0 \Leftrightarrow B$ invertible.

title: Roundtrip: Lattice → Basis → Lattice
content: The roundtrip theorems confirm the custom API and ZSpan are fully interconvertible. `ofBasis_toModuleBasis` shows `(Lattice.ofBasis n (L.toModuleBasis n)).basis = L.basis` — composing the two direction maps is the identity on basis matrices. `covolume_ofBasis_toModuleBasis` shows covolume is preserved under the roundtrip. The key lemma `toModuleBasis_matrix_eq` (proved in the parent file) is the linchpin: it says `Matrix.of (L.toModuleBasis n) = L.basis`, so `Lattice.ofBasis n (L.toModuleBasis n)` has basis `Matrix.of (L.toModuleBasis n) = L.basis`. The two APIs have identical expressive power.

title: IsZLattice Instance: Unlocking the Ecosystem
content: `instIsZLatticeCustom` registers the ZSpan of any custom lattice as an `IsZLattice ℝ` instance via `instIsZLatticeRealSpan`. This one-line instance proof is a gateway: it gives access to the entire `ZLattice` API — `ZLattice.module_free` (the lattice is a free ℤ-module), `ZLattice.rank` (rank equals ambient dimension), `ZLattice.FG` (finite generation) — all for free. This demonstrates that the custom API is fully compatible with the ZLattice ecosystem without any additional work.
mathContext: An `IsZLattice ℝ L` instance means $L \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ is a discrete, cocompact ℤ-submodule spanning $\mathbb{R}^n$. All ZLattice theorems (module structure, rank, etc.) apply automatically.

title: Custom Minkowski as Consequence of ZSpan Minkowski
content: `minkowski_custom_via_zlattice` shows the custom Minkowski theorem follows from the ZSpan-native proof `minkowski_general_lattice_proved`. The bridge requires three conversions: (1) `custom_vol_to_ennreal`: converts the custom volume inequality `hv.volume > criticalVolume n L` to `ENNReal.ofReal |det(Matrix.of (L.toModuleBasis n))| * 2^n < volume S.carrier` using `toModuleBasis_matrix_eq` and careful ENNReal arithmetic; (2) `latticePoints_eq_span`: translates `x ∈ latticePoints n L` (custom span) to `x ∈ ZSpan (L.toModuleBasis n)` (ZSpan); (3) `Subtype.ext`: lifts the nonzero condition from the subtype. The proof demonstrates the custom API is NOT independent — it is a convenient wrapper over the ZSpan framework.
mathContext: The ENNReal conversion requires `ENNReal.ofReal_mul`, `ENNReal.ofReal_pow`, and `ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg` to handle the inequality $|\det B| \cdot 2^n < \mathrm{vol}(S)$, with careful sign conditions.

title: API Design Trade-offs: Custom vs ZSpan/ZLattice
content: The file documents a genuine design choice in Lean formalization. The custom API (`Lattice n`, `latticePoints`, `covolume = |det|`) offers explicit matrix coordinates making it natural for matrix computations, cryptography, and number theory applications. The ZSpan/ZLattice API offers native Mathlib integration — theorems from algebraic geometry, algebraic number theory, and harmonic analysis all speak ZSpan natively. This proof shows the choice is cost-free: the two APIs are mathematically equivalent, and any result proved in one transfers immediately via the bridge lemmas. For new work, ZSpan/ZLattice is preferred for integration; the custom API is preferred when explicit matrix formulas are needed.
mathContext:
| Feature | Custom | ZSpan/ZLattice | Cost to bridge | 
|---------|--------|----------------|----------------| 
| Covolume | $|\det B|$ | $\mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{F})$ | `simp` | 
| Lattice membership | `latticePoints` | `Submodule.span ℤ` | `latticePoints_eq_span` | 
| Minkowski bound | `criticalVolume` | ENNReal form | `custom_vol_to_ennreal` |
